name.ja: BB戦士 LEGENDBB フルアーマー騎士ガンダム（伝説の巨人編Ｖｅｒ．）

description.ja: “　光　の　弓　矢　”　伝　説　の　巨　人　を　射　る　！　！
description.en: Shoot the legendary giant with the “bow and arrow of light”! !

description.en: The two lights written in the mirror of truth are now intersecting -------------------------

description.ja: 「ＬＥＧＥＮＤＢＢ フルアーマー騎士ガンダム」が、 伝説の巨人を倒す“光の弓矢”を携え、装いも豪華な特殊加工を施し、
description.en: "LEGENDBB Full Armor Knight Gundam " carries a " bow and arrow of light" that defeats legendary giants, and his outfit has been specially processed to make it luxurious.

description.ja: ‘伝説の巨人編Ｖｅｒ．’として登場！　ファン必携の決定版！！
description.en: ‘Legendary Titan Edition Ver. Appeared as '! A must-have edition for fans! !

description.ja: ●　メッキ仕上げの“光の弓矢”が 新規で付属！
description.en: ● A new plated “bow and arrow of light” is included!

description.ja: 光の弓矢を新規造形で付属。
description.en: A newly shaped bow and arrow of light is included.

description.ja: 表面には、キラキラ輝く オレンジ系の光沢メッキ加工施し、プレミアム感満点！

description.en: The haze armor and power shield are finished with blue gloss plating.

description.ja: 天空の翼や他外装は、ツヤ感の出るアイスブルーとブルーのグロスインジェクション成形を採用。
description.en: The wings of the sky and other exterior parts are made of ice blue and blue gloss injection molding to give it a glossy look.
